attributes.actualText: Supplier's aggregate liability shall be unlimited in respect of any breach of clause 9 (Data Protection), and otherwise capped at the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
attributes.deviationNotes: Counterparty refused the cap for data-breach claims. Conceded in exchange for Net-30 and a 12-month term rather than 24. Raises composite risk and adds an executive approval step.
